description: Inert placeholder for the agent group, used only by the human-only baseline of paper/main.tex Section 4.1. A baseline team deploys no agents, so every throughput rate (r_F, r_arch_chg, r_fix, r_refactor, r_test, r_doc) and every token price multiplies zero; r_bugs enters only Eq. (Binj-agent), whose impl_agents is zero; d_CR and d_SA are killed by the volume factor Phi(., 0) = 0; d_test and c_test_ceil act on a test suite that never grows; alpha_size lives only inside Phi; and rho_esc scales an agent workload of zero. The values are therefore arbitrary and are copied from the medium tier; the scenario id says a-X rather than a-m so that no tier choice is implied. tests/test_sprint.py pins the inertness.
